title: Semi-Reduced Normal Form
body_html:
Semi-Reduced Normal Form

Two strategies $s_i,t_i$ of player $i$ are payoff-equivalent if for every $s_{-i}$ and every player $j$, $$ g_j(s_i,s_{-i})=g_j(t_i,s_{-i}). $$ The semi-reduced normal form identifies payoff-equivalent strategies. This removes differences that occur only at positions excluded by the strategy itself.
